content.what_happened: The U.S. cattle herd is at its smallest in decades after years of drought. Retail beef prices reached record highs in 2026.
content.why_it_matters: Beef is a large part of many grocery bills. Companies that buy or sell beef see their costs and sales change.

how_it_spreads.step: Drought dried up pasture, so ranchers sold cows instead of keeping them to breed.
how_it_spreads.place: U.S. beef cow herd is in drought-affected areas.

how_it_spreads.step: Fewer cattle reach feedlots, so packers pay more for each animal.
Stores pass the higher wholesale cost on to shoppers.

who_is_affected.name: Tyson Foods
who_is_affected.because: Its beef unit pays more for cattle than it can pass on.
